title: zazzled features
description: Behavior the daemon adds to the commands' answers: session ids and dedupe, read-again, and stored outputs.

entities.name: Session ids and dedupe
entities.description: Within a session, each query answer has a short id, and an answer already sent recently is replaced by a one-line notice.
entities.behavior: When a request carries a session (ZAZZLE_SESSION through the invoker or `zazzled run`; one random `mcp-...` id per `zazzled mcp` process), a find, read, ls, outline or refs answer starts with `[r:ID]`, ID being at least five characters derived from a hash of the session and the text. If the same session was sent the identical text within its last 40,000 estimated tokens, the answer is `[r:ID] already sent: zazzle CMD ARGS, unchanged. If you no longer have it: read-again r:ID`. --disable-session-deduping (MCP disable_session_deduping) sends it in full again.
entities.outcome: An agent is not sent text that is still in its context, and can refer to earlier answers by id.
constraints: No session, no ids and no dedupe.
Edits, errors, status, help and version are never given an id or deduplicated; clean, `zazzle run` and proxied outputs get no session id either, but an output id of their own (stored-outputs).
Sessions live in daemon memory only; a restart forgets them.
At most 64 sessions (the least recently used is dropped) and 512 answers per session (the oldest is dropped).

entities.name: Read again by id
entities.description: An answer can be fetched again by its id: a session response unchanged under the same id or current under a new one; a stored output as it was shown, or in full.
entities.behavior: With each id the session table keeps the command line (without --disable-session-deduping) and working directory that produced it. `zazzle read-again r:ID` (MCP zazzle_read_again) runs that request again in its original working directory and session: if the text is the same, it comes back whole under the same id; if not, it comes back under a new id with `r:OLD changed since it was sent; this is the current version`. A read again never reveals more than the original request did: a terse view stays without a sha. An id the session does not hold (or any id, without a session) is looked up in the output store instead: a stored clean, run or proxy output comes back as it was shown, and with --full (or --lines A-B) its whole input comes back as numbered lines within a budget of 3000 tokens (--budget).
entities.outcome: An agent can drop an answer from its context, or lose it to compaction, keep only its id, and get it back exactly when needed.
constraints: A session response is rerun only within its session, and only while the session table keeps it (512 per session, daemon memory only).
A stored output is there for an hour at most (stored-outputs); --full is refused for a session response, which is never cut.

entities.name: Stored outputs
entities.description: clean, `zazzle run` and proxied outputs, whose input cannot be had again, are kept for an hour under an id, with the input they came from.
entities.behavior: When clean (in the daemon or `zazzled run`), `zazzled wrap` or `zazzled proxy` has an output store, it saves the text it shows and its whole input under a ten-character id derived from both. clean and run answers start with `[r:ID]`, and end with `[full output: read-again r:ID --full]` when something was cut: input past its cap, a budget, a run profile's dropped lines, progress bars, blobs or long lines. The proxy appends to the result, after its items, one item of its own per text it shortened, `[r:ID shortened by zazzle]` (with `; full text: read-again r:ID --full` when something was cut), so a JSON text stays JSON. `read-again r:ID` returns the output as shown; `--full` returns the input with its line numbers. Each save drops entries older than an hour and, past the size limit, the oldest until half the bytes remain.
entities.outcome: An agent can drop a cleaned output from its context, or see what cleaning cut, without running a build or test again or asking the other server again.
constraints: Kept for an hour at most, and less when the store passes its size limit (ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_MAX_GB, default 2).
The store is the directory each process finds in its own environment (ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_DIR, else ~/.zazzle/outputs); a `zazzle run` or proxy output is found only by a daemon using the same one.
Without HOME or ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_DIR nothing is stored and outputs carry no id; a save that fails leaves the output with a note that it was not stored.
